reasoned_checks.details: After push, cursor addresses the oldest frame; history[cursor..] followed by history[..cursor] is chronological. Kernels are ordered j=-H..H around exact t=floor(t)+alpha. At each output the newest input is floor(t)+H, matching the independent centered finite convolution. Phase endpoint bank is available for interpolation without out-of-range reads.

reasoned_checks.area: Exact sample clock and unsigned bounds
reasoned_checks.details: Downsample output occurs only with position<output_rate. position*phase_resolution is below2^40 for u32 rates/resolution<=256. Adding input_rate after an emission is below2^33; initial H*output_rate is below2^42. Because input_rate>output_rate in this branch, subtraction after an emission cannot underflow. Euclidean GCD gives positive phase count after constructor asserts nonzero rates.

Delay is compensated without leading zeros: first logical output is t=0 after H input lookahead. Zero-initialized history and finish zeros supply two-sided finite extension. Existing finite-count convention ceil((N-1)*Fout/Fin) is retained; finish uses u128 products, is idempotent and blocks later process. H<=1024 bounds the1026-frame stack tail. Packet invariance is checked through finish, including empty/single-frame packets and edge-length independent-oracle cases.

Stored PCM input and coefficients accumulate in f64 and undergo exactly one final round/clamp. Fractional evaluation does not interpolate already rounded or clipped FIR PCM. The independent direct-source oracle includes full-scale endpoints; analytic sine checks detect fractional clock/phase errors.

All coefficient/history allocations and trigonometry occur in constructor. Coefficients use at most257*2049*8=4212744 bytes and history at most2049*8=16392 bytes. Exact common clocks need one dot product per output, independent of packet size; bounded fallback interpolates coefficients in the same dot product. process/finish reuse history and prepared caller output storage. Capture RT callback still only enqueues bounded raw data; conversion remains on its existing worker thread.

Five-argument historical reconstruction remains available. Cardinal reconstruction is a distinct explicit mode with exact original samples at integer16k positions, so its frozen legacy16k PCM hashes remain identical while image spectrum changes. Native-input flag reads exact declared48k header without silently reconstructing or resampling at ingestion. Mode flags are mutually exclusive by arity and allow-list. Manual10ms zero extension exceeds the selected<=3ms lookahead, and output count is checked after truncation.

Trusted fixture reader checks RIFF/WAVE tags, actual chunk bounds using checked_add, PCM16 mono format and exact expected rate, even PCM bytes and truncation. Native input cannot accidentally be a16k source labeled48k. Corpus hashes/selection are validated in preparation/replay harnesses, not inferred from this minimal reader alone.

known_limits: Band-edge/latency contract applies to44.1/48/96/192kHz input at16kHz output. Constructor memory remains bounded at arbitrary extreme ratios, but capped kernels do not claim the same transition width there.
Zero allocation requires caller output capacity prepared with output_capacity, as in capture and allocation integration test; a new undersized Vec may grow by design.
Same-rate and upsampling behavior is preserved. New anti-alias/fractional FIR logic is only the downsample branch.
Offline WAV support remains a minimal hashed-fixture parser: RIFF advertised length, byte-rate and block-align are not a generalized strict-RIFF validation contract.

Pre-existing offline WAV writer uses unchecked RIFF size+36 near4GiB output (roughly37hours mono16kPCM). Current small fixed/public corpora are far below this boundary. No source change made in this read-only review.

DSP correctness does not accept the supplemental native WER regression. Retain negative Blackman/Kaiser reports, assess the frozen fresh holdout separately, and keep full native/remote CI/hardware/owner acceptance distinct.
